R-hierarchy.reason: On discover, the search bar, featured photo carousel, category chips, and recipe list establish clear scan order without competing elements; on recipe-detail, the hero photo, headline, metadata pills, and filled Save recipe button clearly lead.

R-fill.reason: At most one strong saturated fill competes for attention on each screen, such as the primary Save recipe button on recipe-detail and the single small tertiaryContainer skillet emblem on discover.

R-surfaces.reason: Warm tonal surfaces (surface, surfaceBright on detail, surfaceContainerHigh on search and list items, surfaceContainerLow on the Ingredients card, and secondaryContainer for active selection) clearly group content without flattening hierarchy.

R-controls.reason: Every interactive element reads as its own distinct tappable control: navigation bar/rail items, contained search bar, clickable carousel cards, outlined/tonal FilterChips, SegmentedListItems, TopAppBar back IconButton, and 56dp Save recipe Button.

R-font.reason: Bundled Fraunces is used with deliberate editorial weight on display and titleLarge headings (Simmer, Discover, This week, Browse, Shakshuka, Ingredients, Method), while Google Sans Flex carries body/list text and Google Sans Code handles tabular times, ratings, servings, and step numbers.

R-platform.reason: Follows Android conventions edge to edge with no iOS disclosure chevrons on list rows and no Cancel/Done text buttons in the top bar.

R-text.reason: In discover-desktop.png, the second featured card in the This week carousel shows a caption pill whose title truncates mid-word to "Miso mushro..." because maxLines = 1 clips it inside the 440dp browse pane.

R-dark.reason: Both discover-dark.png and recipe-detail-dark.png are crisp and legible, with light text/icons on dark surfaces, dark text on the peach Save recipe button, and high contrast on the yellow skillet badge and caption pill.

R-adaptive.reason: Navigation shifts from ShortNavigationBar on phone to collapsed WideNavigationRail on foldable/tablet and expanded WideNavigationRail on desktop; discover-tablet and discover-desktop reveal the recipe detail pane alongside the list, and recipe-detail-desktop reveals Method alongside Ingredients.

R-idea.reason: The Editorial Cookbook direction combines warm terracotta-cream tones, Fraunces editorial headers, tabular Google Sans Code recipe metrics, a 9-sided cookie skillet motif, and a food-led hero carousel into a cohesive culinary experience.

R-semantics.reason: All section headings (discover header, This week, Browse, Ingredients, Method) carry Modifier.semantics { heading() }, category FilterChips are single Material controls, and no list row embeds a separate Switch, Checkbox, or RadioButton callback.

R-fields.reason: The search field uses TextFieldState with SearchBarDefaults.InputField(textFieldState = textFieldState, searchBarState = searchBarState) rather than a value/onValueChange String overload.

R-visibility.reason: All shown/hidden UI (single-pane detail, navigation bar vs rail, second pane, carousel section, empty state, back bar, and recipe switching) uses conditional if branches or AnimatedContent rather than zero-alpha hiding.

R-blur.reason: No Modifier.blur is used anywhere in the proposal, and carousel captions sit inside opaque surfaceContainerLowest Surface cards for readability.

R-recipes-browse.reason: Search sits at the top in a SearchBar, featured recipes lead with food photography in a HorizontalCenteredHeroCarousel with high-contrast surface pills for titles, and categories use FilterChips above SegmentedListItems.
